positions.title: Mentor
positions.description:
One-on-one mentoring for students interested in CS
Teach fundamentals and guide students through exciting projects in Python

positions.title: CS 61A Tutor
positions.description:
•	Taught weekly section for 5-6 students to review class topics and introductory programming concepts using Python
•	Created problems to challenge students and hone their basic python skills such as trees and lists
•	Assisted students in homework and projects in Python during weekly office hours

company.name: UC Berkeley Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Integrated Chaos Engineering by designing and implementing a test harness using Markov chains to create chaos in Workday’s core system in order to determine impact of failure and points of weakness
•	Architected Go Continuous Deployment Pipeline to automate instantiating system and running test harness
•	Created JUnit tests using Mockito to ensure correctness of harness actions
•	Improved Workday’s ability to scale horizontally instead of vertically to deal with Big Data

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description:
Senior Patrol Leader (1 year)
Patrol Leader (6 months)
Troop Guide (1 year)

volunteerExperiences.description: I went to monthly training sessions in Monterey, California to develop my leadership skills. After one year, the entire staff would lead a camp with over 300 youth to teach them leadership skills. I did this for every year. In 2013 I was the assistant leader of the entire group.

-Attended one local under-resourced high school weekly to teach students in Computer Science per semester
-Planned 24 hour hackathon tailored towards students of the schools we serve

projects.title: Midpoint
projects.description: Used HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Here API to create a website which allows users to input two addresses and select a type of activity. It will return the midpoint based on driving time and things to do around the midpoint.

projects.title: Revi-Dict
projects.description: I created a website that allows input of several words and will return a string of words that are synonyms and likely match the word that you are looking for. Used HTML, Flask, Python, and Big Huge Thesaurus API.
